messages:
Mike L: heads up — p99 latency spike hitting us-west serving pool starting ~11:04 UTC. p99 went from ~120ms to ~1.2s. alert from infra. anyone oncall?
incident-bot: [ALERT] latency_spike detected on cluster=us-west-serving pool=prod-serving-3 at 2025-03-05T11:04:18Z. p95/p99 thresholds breached.
Sara P: I'm on it. pulled a quick profile — looks like we started using a much slower kernel (matmul_v2_fallback) instead of matmul_opt for several big layers after the quantization tweak last night. also kv-cache allocations shot up. pasting short snapshot.
Sara P: ```
Profiler snapshot 11:05 UTC
  kernel matmul_opt        p50 0.8ms  p95 2.1ms
  kernel matmul_v2_fallback p50 10.2ms p95 45.8ms
KV cache delta: +1.2GB in 2m (prefetch.enabled = true)
batcher: avg_batch_size 12 -> 38 (auto-increase due to new batching heuristic)
Top host: us-west-gpu-3: GPU mem pressure 92%
```
Jen H: that aligns with node telemetry — a large training job landed on us-west-gpu-3 at 11:03 and is hogging memory + PCIe bandwidth. Noisy neighbor + kernel switch = big perf hit.
Mike L: ouch. do we have a quick mitigation path?
Sourabh: short list of actions we can do now (low risk first):
  1) set runtime override to reduce max_batch_size to 16 (prevents huge batching blowups)
  2) disable kernel auto-selector temporarily (so we avoid falling back to matmul_v2_fallback)
  3) turn off kv cache prefetch for the pool (reclaims ~1GB immediately)
  4) route non-SLA traffic to redwood-lite variant for a few minutes
Sourabh: snippet to push as a hotfix:```yaml
# runtime hotpatch (apply to prod-serving-3)
runtime:
  max_batch_size: 16
  kernel_selector:
    enabled: false
  kv_cache:
    prefetch: false
routing:
  - match: "!token.sla==true"
    model: redwood-lite-v1
```
Dani Ops: I'm cordoning the noisy node and throttling the training job now. will also create a temporary quota for that namespace. doing in 2m.
Dani Ops: /k cordon us-west-gpu-3 && /k drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data us-west-gpu-3 (doing safe drain)
incident-bot: Incident action: change pushed: runtime.max_batch_size=16, kernel_selector.enabled=false, kv_cache.prefetch=false on pool prod-serving-3 by Dani Ops at 11:09:12 UTC. Routing rule added for non-SLA to redwood-lite-v1.
Mike L: after hotpatch p99 dropped back to ~140ms at 11:12. still watching. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sara P: saving profiler snapshots and logs to /s3/perf/2025-03-05/us-west/1752003456.tar.gz. creating bug for kernel_selector regression + test coverage gap.
Jen H: we should also add a health-check guard that prevents auto-batcher from growing > configured_max when mem pressure > 80%. filing follow-up RFC.
Sourabh: agreed. next steps: postmortem, add unit/integration test for kernel selector shapes, and a perf CI run on quantized models.
Mike L: assigning follow-ups: @Sara P bug, @Jen H RFC, @Sourabh perf CI. I'll draft incident note for on-call channel.
Dani Ops: posting status update to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded -> Mitigated" and linking this thread.
Mike L: good postmortem candidate. closing incident once we verify 30m stable.
